### AI Mode reply for digital kvp and mas chart

![kVp and mAs ranges](data:image/jpeg;base64,) A digital kVp and mAs technique chart is ==a standardized guide used in radiography to select the proper kilovoltage peak and milliampere-seconds for specific body parts and patient sizes==.

Core Definitions

- **kVp (Kilovoltage Peak):** Controls the energy and penetrating power of the X-ray beam, which determines image contrast.
	YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

- **mAs (Milliampere-seconds):** Controls the total quantity of radiation produced, which directly affects image receptor exposure and density.
	YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

- **SID (Source-to-Image Distance):** The distance from the X-ray tube to the digital receptor, standardly 40 inches or 72 inches depending on the exam.
	YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

General Reference Ranges by Body Part

- **Chest (PA & Lateral):**
	- kVp: 110–120 (with grid) / 80–90 (portable, non-grid)
	- mAs: 2–8
	- SID: 72 inches
		YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

- **Abdomen (KUB / Upright):**
	- kVp: 75–80
	- mAs: 5–40
	- SID: 40 inches
		YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

- **Extremities (Hand, Foot, Wrist):**
	- kVp: 55–60
	- mAs: 1.5–5
	- SID: 40 inches
		YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

- **Spine (Thoracic & Lumbar):**
	- kVp: 75–90
	- mAs: 10–40
	- SID: 40 inches
		YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy +1

Fixed vs. Variable Systems

- **Fixed-kVp Systems:** Uses an optimal, preset kVp for each specific body part while adjusting only the mAs for patient thickness. Digital systems heavily favor this method to reduce patient dose and maintain uniform contrast.
	Pressbooks.pub

- **Variable-kVp Systems:** Adjusts the kVp upward as tissue thickness increases (typically using a formula like 2 kVp per cm added to a base kVp) while keeping mAs static.
	Pressbooks.pub

- Note: Exact numbers vary based on your specific digital detector manufacturer, departmental protocols, and equipment calibration. Consult your site's [Official Radiology Guidelines](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4175850/) for clinical use.
	YouTube·LearnRadiologyWithMy

Further Exploration

- Review baseline exposure concepts from [Radiology Key](https://radiologykey.com/radiographic-exposure-technique/).

- Explore technical factors in the [Open Procedure Guide](https://umsystem.pressbooks.pub/proceduresrev/back-matter/appendix-a-exp-factors-img-acq/).
